## Risk Review

- [ ] No provider keys, local databases, logs, terminal output, private workspace data, or generated build artifacts are included
- [ ] Auth, terminal, file write, full-computer scope, provider key, and tool-execution changes are called out
- [ ] Destructive or high-risk behavior has explicit confirmation UI
- [ ] Documentation was updated when contributor behavior, setup, permissions, or public APIs changed
